TOOL_PREFERENCES (permanent):
- str_replace: HINT PRIORITY (strongest first): inFunction / afterSymbol/beforeSymbol / afterFunction/beforeFunction / afterString/beforeString / lineContentHint / lineNumberHint. Prefer drift-immune content hints over positional lineNumberHint.
- Standard workflow: grep-file → read-lines → str_replace with hint. Always lineNumberHint on files >100 lines as minimum.
- save-all instead of save-file. save-all silently skips unchanged files — normal.
- open-file before str_replace when editor focus may have shifted (wrong active editor → 'closest area found' errors).
- get-repo-map is MANDATORY second step after reading session notes. Call before any grep/read/list.
- save-all MUST come before node --check — node reads disk not buffer. get-diagnostics reads live buffer so is safe before save.
- checkpatch filePath: always use full absolute path from list-open-files.
- run-command: PowerShell uses ; not && as command separator.
- replace-document: USE for any edit touching a markdown table (pipes break str_replace matching).

TOOL_QUIRKS (permanent):
- delete-block: startContent/endContent anchors work well for multi-line dead-code removal.
- sed: always dryRun:true first. Unreliable on module.exports lines near template literals.
- apply-patch: LIFETIME near-zero hits — avoid. Use str_replace+hints instead.
- replace-function-body: ambiguous when function name appears 6+ times. Use afterHint or occurrence:N. Unreliable near TOOL_CATALOGUE export const — use str_replace+lineNumberHint in that zone.
- replace-across-files: glob must always be lib/*.js — NEVER **/*.js (hits .mcp-baseline/ backup).
- inFunction hint does NOT work for registerTool blocks — tool name is a string arg, not a JS function name. Use lineNumberHint + delete-line-range+insert instead.

LESSONS (permanent):
1. replace-across-files glob must be lib/*.js — NEVER **/*.js (hits .mcp-baseline/).
2. str_replace afterHint on common string may match wrong site — use lineNumberHint only, or add fuzzyWhitespace:true.
3. Multi-internal-edits to one function: go straight to replace-function-body with lineNumberHint — never chain str_replace inside a single function.
4. sed unreliable on module.exports lines near template literals. Always dryRun:true first.
5. node --check catches embedded */ inside block comments. Never write /* ... */ ... */ on one line.
6. replace-function-body near TOOL_CATALOGUE export const is unreliable — use str_replace+lineNumberHint.
7. save-all before running Get-Content / grep in PowerShell — reads disk not buffer.
8. lineNumberHint ambiguity guard: when old_str matched N times in ±25 window, use occurrence:N shown in preview.
9. str_replace with ${} template literal in old_str always times out on mcp-registration.js — use delete-line-range + insert.
10. ESLint espree chokes on lines >~800 chars — split long desc strings with + concat.
11. insert afterContent inserts AFTER the matched line. To insert before a line use insert_line:N directly.
12. open-file required before any insert on CHANGELOG or any file not currently active.
13. beforeString with occurrence:1 still fails when string appears in multiple sections — use insert_line with just-read absolute line number.
14. When adding new top-level key to editStats: add defensive ||{} guards to ALL direct-access sites in getEditStats session block.
15. delete-line-range dryRun first is essential before any structural block deletion.
16. Only destructure what mcp-registration.js actually calls directly from new lib requires — internal helpers flagged as unused by ESLint.
17. fuzzyContent + inFunction scope conflict: ambiguity guard fires on global buffer before function scope is applied. Workaround: use occurrence:N + lineNumberHint instead of inFunction.
18. fuzzyContent on comment lines: use inFunction or betweenHint, never lineNumberHint alone (autoStripComment strips trailing comment leaving too-short fragment).
CHAT PANEL:
- paste/drop events must be on this.element at capture phase (3rd arg true) + stopImmediatePropagation().
- await in activate() can delay past onDidActivateInitialPackages — always guard with hasActivatedInitialPackages() check.
- this.X never available inside express route handlers — use module-level vars.
- MCP SDK callTool() returns { content: [{type,text},...], isError? } — always extract text via content.map(c => c.text ?? '').join('\n'), never JSON.stringify it.
